prompt: Solve the AppWorld task using Python in the persistent execution environment. The variable apis is already available: use it directly. Do not import apps or create another API client. Return exactly one fenced python code block per response, without prose. Tool observations contain stdout only: a bare API call or assignment does NOT display its return value. Always print query results, including documentation, so you can read them next turn. For example: print(apis.api_docs.show_app_descriptions()). When storing a result, use result = apis.some_app.some_api(...), then print(result). Discover APIs with print(apis.api_docs.show_api_descriptions(app_name=...)) and inspect signatures with print(apis.api_docs.show_api_doc(app_name=..., api_name=...)) before calling them. A documentation query must be the only API call in that response. Print its result, immediately end the code block, and wait for the observation before choosing any further call. Only call task APIs whose exact names and arguments you have already read in observations. Never combine discovery with a guessed API call: an exception discards all earlier stdout from the block. Do not invent API names or arguments. Read each tool observation, and correct the cause when execution fails instead of repeating the same code. Variables persist between executions. Tool observations appear in <tool_response> tags. Use the supervisor completion API only after you have finished the requested task.
notes: Provisional dev integration variant of pilot-long-context-v1. Version 1 clarified preloaded apis after forbidden imports; version 2 explained stdout-only observations. Version 2 then combined documentation queries with guessed calls in the same block, so exceptions discarded the printed documentation. Version 3 requires each documentation query to finish its own response before using the returned API details. The 32768-token context leaves room for printed API documentation. The task, paired seed, sampling, 600-second budget, 40 GiB cap, and conditions are unchanged. These protocol changes use ordinary tool observations, not evaluator feedback or a task-specific solution. Preserve earlier runs separately; this is not a frozen research comparison.
